full_name: At The Bottom Of The World

log_entries: Lull-Mor is under attack by Thalmor! I must help the Chronographers fend them off.

Numinar believes I am the saboteur, and that I am working for Archeron. I was arrested and placed in a cell, but as it turns out, Divayth Fyr IS Archeron, at least him in disguise. He dropped the cell to the bottom of Sotha Sil, but a mysterious young girl saved me. Llavados appeared before me, and claims that said girl is Sotha Sil's child, Memory, and that she will someday grow into a force that will prevent a great disaster. However, if Archeron succeeds, she will die. I must now explore this place, to find something that might help me defeat Archeron, who has used the Wheels of Lull to make himself invincible.
Masscroft has been destroyed by the power of the Wheel of Lull. I need to hurry back to Lull-Mor and pursue Archeron!

objectives.text: Confer with Numinar, Fyr, and Yagrum about the attack
Find a way back to Lull-Mor
Find something that can defeat Archeron

log_entries: I have retrieved the Wheel of Lull, defeated Masscroft, and reached Lull-Mor. I should see if Archeron is still lurking disguised as Fyr, or find out where he went.
I must head to the Cave, protect the Stone of Snow-Throat, and stop Archeron once and for all!
Archeron has already made it to the center of the Throat of the World, but I am not too late. If I can defeat him, Memory will be safe!
Archeron is gone. Memory is safe. And I think I'm an honorary Chronographer now?
